project.name: 畸变前线
project.description: 从玩法原型到可交付资产的制作工作台

versions.title: 畸变前线
versions.subtitle: 最初的猎场
versions.summary: 第三人称末世变异体动作搜打撤原型。选择裂爪或棘骨，在污染区搜集基因、战斗进化，再携带资源撤回巢穴。
features: 三段近战 / 骨刺 / 范围异能
versions.limits: 单人 AI 原型，程序化简模与节点驱动动作，无多人联网。

versions.title: 异能与兵器
versions.subtitle: 角色与武器解耦
versions.summary: 五位角色自由搭配六类武器，加入双武器切换、蓄力反制、钩索移动与垂直探索。角色异能和武器系统独立组合。
features: 双武器 / 蓄力 / 反制 / 钩索
6 个强化 AI · 10 分钟撤离
versions.limits: 单人原型；AI 为轻量避障，美术和动作仍为程序生成。

versions.title: 晴昼遗城
versions.subtitle: 当前可玩版本
versions.summary: 奶油色建筑、青绿构件与紫色植被构成晴昼旧城。延续五角色、六武器的搜打撤玩法，改善鼠标锁定与场景渲染，为后续正式资产制作提供原型基线。
features: 晴昼旧城 · 港区与高架列车
标准鼠标锁定 / 灵敏度调节
versions.limits: 静态角色概念图和新增技能方案尚未接入运行时；当前游戏仍使用程序化模型。

versions.title: 晴湾远征
versions.subtitle: 多区探索与条件撤离
versions.summary: 五角色立绘与技能图标接入，六片相连街区、五种条件撤离、38 处物资箱与动态增援。攻击采用前摇、命中帧和收势，新增战术异能、负重、治疗、委托及物资结算。
features: 六个区域 · 五种条件撤离 · 14 分钟远征
五角色三异能 · 命中帧 / 闪避取消 / 破势
搜箱 / 负重 / 治疗 / 空投 / 委托 / 仓库结算
versions.limits: 单人对 AI 原型。角色与建筑仍为程序化模型，未使用 Blender 骨骼动画；本轮完成代码与碰撞通路测试，未完成实机视觉验收。

roles.name: 烬刃
roles.identity: adult athletic man with swept short charcoal hair and the same sharp face; coral cropped jacket with split hem, large ivory armor on HIS RIGHT shoulder, glowing geometric seams on RIGHT forearm, dark teal trousers, one hip salvage pouch and ivory/charcoal boots. Preserve exact construction, facial features and body proportions of the LEFT hero in the reference.
roles.portrait: Confident forward-stepping three-quarter pose, entire body visible. RIGHT hand holds the reference single-edged long sword angled outward and downward clear of feet. Left hand relaxed near belt, a restrained angular ember ribbon at right forearm. Focused face looking just past viewer; jacket hem has a little motion. Sword hilt and fingers credible.

skills.name: 炎步
skills.summary: 向前突进，沿途留下短暂灼烧路径。
skills.action: 压低身体蓄势，右肩领身冲出，后脚蹬地，末端落脚制动。
skills.visual: 窄橙色拖尾与断续地面余烬，角色轮廓始终清楚。
skills.counter: 从侧面躲开路径，利用突进结束时的收势窗口反击。
skills.pose: a low aggressive forward dash, front knee driving forward, trailing leg extended, right ember forearm leading, sword sheathed; one narrow coral streak behind body and sparse short ember marks on ground

skills.name: 灰烬封线
skills.summary: 在前方铺出一条短暂灼烧带，压缩敌人的进退路线。
skills.action: 左脚踏稳，晶化右掌向地面横扫，收掌时形成横向封锁带。
skills.visual: 低矮断续火线与清楚的落地区域，不形成遮挡视线的火墙。
skills.counter: 观察铺设前摇后绕行或跳越；封锁带持续时间有限。
skills.pose: wide planted stance, torso turned and RIGHT glowing forearm sweeping low across body, palm facing floor; a short low coral segmented ember line lies horizontally ahead with small flat chevrons; no sword attack and no tall flame wall

skills.name: 焚身领域
skills.summary: 释放火焰冲击，短时间内攻击附带灼烧。
skills.action: 双臂收至胸前聚力，踏地展开，随后进入前倾战斗架势。
skills.visual: 薄橙色地面冲击环、手臂与武器窄边光，躯干不被火焰遮住。
skills.counter: 拉开距离等待强化结束，避免在其有效范围内连续换血。
skills.pose: wide grounded stance just after arms expand from chest, short orange radial ground pulse, fine orange edge light on forearms and sheathed sword, determined lifted chin; no giant fireball

roles.name: 霜序
roles.identity: adult slim athletic woman with the same short dark teal bob and aqua front streak, same calm face; ivory angular short coat with teal lining and split rear tails, navy fitted pants and ivory/teal boots. HER LEFT arm is entirely translucent angular aqua crystal, RIGHT arm is human. In front view crystal arm is at viewer's right. Keep exact left/right anatomy, haircut, garment shapes and proportions of CENTER hero in reference.
roles.portrait: Calm active three-quarter full-body stance, one foot forward, human RIGHT hand holds compact reference crossbow angled down away from body. Crystalline LEFT palm open at chest height carrying a small floating angular aqua shard. Entire bow, boots and hands visible, face turned toward viewer.

skills.name: 霜锁
skills.summary: 投射霜晶，命中目标后施加短暂冻结与减速。
skills.action: 侧身迈步，以晶化左掌瞄准推出，右臂向后平衡。
skills.visual: 一枚尖锥霜晶、短蓝色轨迹及目标脚下冰缚。
skills.counter: 利用投射方向与前摇侧闪，避免直线追击。
skills.pose: forward step and a focused extended crystalline LEFT palm launches ONE narrow aqua ice shard toward a small distant training silhouette; human right arm balances behind, crossbow stowed

skills.name: 冰棱陷阱
skills.summary: 放置可被破坏的冰棱装置，敌人接近时触发一次减速。
skills.action: 半蹲将晶化左掌压向地面，冰棱成形后迅速起身。
skills.visual: 低矮三棱晶体与细菱形地面轮廓，触发时向外裂开。
skills.counter: 发现后摧毁或绕开；陷阱不持续追踪远处敌人。
skills.pose: one-knee low crouch planting LEFT crystalline palm on floor to form a compact 30-centimeter triangular ice prism on a thin diamond-shaped ground pad, right hand balances; tiny outward fracture marks, no towering crystals

skills.name: 静寂之境
skills.summary: 释放范围冻结，并恢复自身部分生命。
skills.action: 屈膝收势后展开双臂，左掌下压，冰环沿地面扩散。
skills.visual: 细同心冰环与少量边缘冰片，身体周围有淡青恢复光点。
skills.counter: 识别地面范围及时退出，避免多人聚集在释放中心。
skills.pose: wide grounded stance with crystalline LEFT palm down and human right arm open; two thin cyan ground rings and a few short angular ice teeth at far circumference, 3 subtle healing motes near chest

roles.name: 岚影
roles.identity: lean adult androgynous hunter with warm brown skin, same angular face and short asymmetric BLACK hair, lavender short jacket with a single large ivory LEFT shoulder plate, pale stone fitted trousers, dark knee pieces, violet boots and geometric phase marks on LEFT arm. Match RIGHT hero in reference; no white hair or face changes.
roles.portrait: Elastic three-quarter ready stance, weight on rear leg, one short violet-edged blade in each hand held away from the body, one pointing down and one angled sideways. Entire blades and feet within frame. Face focused, a single narrow violet broken-diamond arc behind left shoulder, no duplicate solid person.

skills.name: 相位闪
skills.summary: 向选定方向短距闪现，并强化下一次攻击。
skills.action: 压肩侧踏进入相位，出现在终点时以低姿前脚落地。
skills.visual: 断开的紫色菱形边框与短拖尾，终点落脚有简洁标记。
skills.counter: 预判终点并保留反制，避免只追逐出发残影。
skills.pose: low forward stride emerging from ONE broken violet diamond outline, distinct departing faint silhouette behind, both blades sheathed, feet planted at destination

skills.name: 留影诱饵
skills.summary: 投放沿指定方向移动的短暂残影，制造脚步与假动作。
skills.action: 左手向外甩出相位组织，本体低姿向侧面撤开。
skills.visual: 一个半透明紫色替身与离散足迹，本体保持实色。
skills.counter: 观察残影的透明断面与固定路径，避免过早交出技能。
skills.pose: solid hero crouches and peels sideways while LEFT hand flicks outward; exactly ONE translucent violet full-body decoy runs in a different direction, 3 simple violet footstep marks distinguish decoy path; no clones crowd

skills.name: 幽影乱舞
skills.summary: 对附近目标发动连续相位突袭。
skills.action: 蓄势后连续切换攻击位置，每次落点都有短促收势。
skills.visual: 三处离散落点与短紫色连接线，实体角色只出现一次。
skills.counter: 拉开队伍间距并离开可锁定范围，利用落点提示判断方向。
skills.pose: ONE solid hero in airborne diagonal striking pose, two held short blades visible, TWO small translucent arc-like afterimages near two distant marked landing points, narrow segmented violet links between points, no whole-screen vortex

roles.name: 玄岩
roles.identity: large sturdy adult human man with same visible warm brown face and short black hair, asymmetrical large ivory bone plates on LEFT shoulder and left upper torso over teal utility suit, ochre accents, left forearm bone shield, broad practical boots, coral waist strap. Keep same body mass and exact armor layout of LEFT hero in reference; never robot helmet.
roles.portrait: Broad protective full-body three-quarter pose, right hand on long original hammer handle with ivory hammer head resting on ground beside right boot, LEFT shield forearm angled outward exposing face and torso, chin raised confidently. Full hammer and boots visible, very small pale-gold angular shards near shield only.

skills.name: 骨盾
skills.summary: 展开骨质护盾，短时间内显著减伤。
skills.action: 前脚踏稳、左肘抬起，数块骨板向前展开承击。
skills.visual: 连接左臂的实体六角骨板，受击边缘闪出短金色碎光。
skills.counter: 侧向牵制并等待防护结束，避免正面持续换血。
skills.pose: heavy defensive lunge with LEFT forearm raised and compact attached ivory hexagonal shield plates open, 3 golden sparks at shield edge; right hand keeps hammer low and visible

skills.name: 骨垒
skills.summary: 在近处生成可被破坏的低矮骨垒，用于掩护搜集和撤离。
skills.action: 俯身将左拳压地，肩背骨板张开后向前生成骨垒。
skills.visual: 三块并排、腰部高度的象牙色骨板，地面有窄金色预示线。
skills.counter: 绕侧、翻越或集中破坏；骨垒不能完全封死通道。
skills.pose: one-knee braced low stance, armored LEFT fist pressed to ground while 3 attached-looking but freestanding broad ivory plates rise in a waist-high short line ahead; hammer securely on back, not in casting hand

skills.name: 地裂震荡
skills.summary: 释放地面冲击，击飞附近敌人并恢复部分耐力。
skills.action: 抬起重心蓄势，再重踏并以左拳砸地，将力量向外传导。
skills.visual: 低矮金色冲击环与少量大块翘起地面，保持视线清楚。
skills.counter: 观察明显蓄势后拉开距离，避免围在角色脚边。
skills.pose: deep wide squat at instant of massive LEFT armored fist contacting floor, right arm drawn back balancing, hammer stowed; a low pale gold radial shock ring and 4 broad displaced ground slabs, no giant dust cloud

roles.name: 裂爪
roles.identity: lean fully nonhuman humanoid creature matching RIGHT figure of reference: angular ivory carapace, moss-turquoise body, long functional arms, digitigrade legs and clawed feet, narrow wedge-shaped nonhuman face with lime eyes, three compact pale-lime dorsal ridges, purple utility sash and small salvage canister. EXACTLY two arms and two legs, no tail, no wings, no new horns; same anatomy and proportions.
roles.portrait: Alert low three-quarter hunter stance with chest angled toward viewer, head turned toward viewer and closed mouth, original simple spear held in one useful hand upright but diagonally outward; other claw relaxed with fingers visible. Entire spear tip, both feet and dorsal ridges visible. Small clean lime accent slashes only, not monstrous gore.

skills.name: 猎扑
skills.summary: 朝目标方向扑进并造成冲击。
skills.action: 后腿深蹲压缩后猛蹬，腾空伸爪，落地屈膝承重。
skills.visual: 清楚的短扑击轨迹与小范围落地碎片。
skills.counter: 在其腾空后横移，并利用落地收势窗口。
skills.pose: horizontal airborne hunting pounce, arms reaching forward and digitigrade legs extending back, same anatomy and ivory carapace, spear stowed securely on back, projected ground shadow

skills.name: 脉冲嗅猎
skills.summary: 发出短程感知脉冲，短暂提示附近敌人的移动痕迹。
skills.action: 低头停步嗅探，背部骨棱轻张，随后沿地面释放脉冲。
skills.visual: 浅青绿色断续扫描弧与少量足迹提示，不持续透视敌人。
skills.counter: 利用其短暂探查前摇调整位置；提示范围和保留时间有限。
skills.pose: crouched tracking stance with head low and one claw hovering near ground, dorsal ridges slightly open, two thin interrupted lime scan arcs and 3 small geometric footprint marks on ground ahead; no floating eye icon over hero

skills.name: 狂猎
skills.summary: 短时间提高攻击速度，并通过命中恢复自身生命。
skills.action: 脊背拱起蓄势、骨棱张开，随后进入低重心快速追击姿态。
skills.visual: 原有骨棱边缘亮起，双爪短促残迹，身体不膨胀变形。
skills.counter: 拉开距离并阻止持续命中，等待强化结束再交战。
skills.pose: aggressive low forward sprint with one claw striking outward and the other drawn back, existing dorsal ridges glowing lime only at edges, 3 short clean claw crescents and tiny healing diamond motes near chest, no body transformation, spear stowed
